def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = []
    for tile_r in range(3):
        for r in range(h):
            src_r = h - 1 - r if tile_r % 2 == 0 else r
            row = grid[src_r]
            out.append(list(reversed(row)) + list(row))
    return out

def transform(grid):
    """Mirror the grid leftward and above/below, keeping the original at right/center."""
    vertical = list(reversed(grid)) + [list(row) for row in grid] + list(reversed(grid))
    return [list(reversed(row)) + list(row) for row in vertical]
